mentions.name: Google Sheets-backed workout tracker
mentions.description: A workout tracker backed by Google Sheets that makes it easy to see which workouts have been done or missed recently and to pick the next thing to do. The author plans to open source it after some refactoring ("de-monolithing").
mentions.problem: It can be hard to see what workouts have been done or not done recently and to pick the next thing to do.
mentions.audience: Makes it easy for the author personally to review workout history and choose what to do next (personal tool).
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on a Google-sheet backed workout tracker, which basically makes it easy for me to see what I've done or not done recently and pick the next thing to do. I'm thinking of open sourcing this soon, but need to do some "de-monolithing" first.
